explanation: Peaks at D1 and depends mostly on the previous trial reward and on how late in the episode it is: D1 after a reward is about 5-7 before trial ~70 and 8-10 after trial ~85, while D1 after no reward is about 1-3 early and 4-8 late. GO is lower (1-2 early, 4-6 late, about 1 point higher after choosing a2), and D2 is lowest (0-1 early, 1-4 late, about 2 points higher when the state reached is S2 than S1).
